description.purpose: The end of the wait for a turn's route stamp (GH #1564). It carries no schedule of its own: `./assemble` orders one one-shot named `route_wait` per turn that waits for its stamp, at the window leg + `route_wait_ms` (or the end of a route-hold notice), re-armed in place (`rearm`) and taken back (`remove`) when the stamp lands or the turn fires first.
description.use_when: Always, as part of the collector. It is not a poll (GH #553): every strike has a name and a time, and with `route_wait_ms` 0 nothing is ever ordered.
description.not_in_scope: No cron, no recurring schedule. What a strike means is the `in_route_wake` lane the hive's edge stamps on it; a strike for a turn that already fired finds its window leg fired and does nothing.
